phases.name: finalize
phases.contract: Existing separately authenticated administrator executes fixed, release-bound SQL on the intended DB. No arbitrary SQL/object/owner input. Use one transaction, fixed ordered relation locks, local lock_timeout 5s and statement_timeout 60s. Validate exact relation kinds, columns, constraints and validated composite FKs, source ownership, zero membership reachability, expected ACLs, no partition/inheritance or shadow relations, and emptiness before any ownership change. Transfer exact six relations to fixed owners, remove only expected staging ACLs, recheck final catalog and all effective table/column/SET access before commit. Unknown owner, mixed ownership, nonempty staging, unexpected grants, shape or trigger/rule drift fails with no repair. Finalized exact state is read-only idempotent success; never transfer back to console_app.

phases.name: admit
phases.contract: For DB-backed api and worker, AppState::from_config performs the shared catalog custody verifier before returning a usable state or starting consumers; readyz rechecks actual metadata and returns unavailable on missing, partial, pending or drifted custody. Direct binary launch cannot bypass this gate. Migrate is exempt from serving custody admission so it can create staging. The existing genuine no-database test configuration follows its existing behavior and cannot be enabled to bypass a configured DB failure. Deployment finalization success is required in addition to, not instead of, live catalog readback. The verifier requires no private-row reads, administrator secret or new access grants. Account enrollment remains disabled until its independent global fence and owner contracts pass.

The shared SQL independently checks exact physical prerequisites and is the same statement boundary used by marked SQLx fixtures and raw migration experiments. Raw probes lack SQLx ledger legitimately, invoke shared SQL directly through their administrator, retain source/order execution manifest, and cannot be claimed as production-wrapper or app startup proof.

future_ddl: This v1 finalizer is a single immutable six-table custody transition, not a generic privileged migration engine. Once transferred, console_app cannot ALTER these tables or add referencing FKs without separate authority. Subsequent Account/credential/actor DDL must use versioned operator-owned transitions through the same isolated operator lifecycle, with exact migration order/checksum, populated-data compatibility and tests approved before that lane. Never reclaim ownership, add REFERENCES/SET grants, or widen v1 silently. This is a dependency of the next Account lane and remains HOLD, not an omitted production guarantee.
rollback: Before enrollment, a failed finalizer transaction rolls back all changes and leaves empty staging inaccessible. On uncertain commit, inspect exact whole post-state; completed state succeeds read-only, pending state retries the same bounded transaction, mixed/drifted state stops. Do not drop tables, erase history, restore legacy credentials or revoke Account fences. Software rollback differs from data rollback; no down migration or automatic custody reversal.
